I prefer 'Quảng noodle', 'bún riêu', 'bánh canh', stir-fried noodle (ganerally different kinds of noodle), 'bánh bèo', hot pot,...

In my opinion, the restaurant should be more popular than it actually is.

What! No meat?????
Nov 2016 • Friends
Being an avid carnivore, I was a bit apprehensive when my friend said that be are going to a vegetarian restaurant.

This apprehension soon disappeared as soon as I tasted the starter of steam rice cake. I never knew that rice can be so yummy,

Next came Lotus Broken Rice. Although I have been to Vietnam many time, this was my first venture tucking into broken rice. Verdict? Absolutely wonderful. Best way to describe the texture is that it is bouncy.

Next came the mushroom hot pot. Another delightful experience. The broth was very excellent with a wonderful balance of flavours of earthy mushroom and vegetables.

Another highlight was the Kumquat drink. Don't know how to describe the taste but the fact that I had a second serving is testament to my partiality to the taste.

Will definitely go back there again. Then again, I might not.... might run the risk of being converted to a vegetarian. 🤔
